verdict.rationale: Caveman ships as a skill and an open-source CLI that wraps agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, so asking how it installs is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a non-interactive, promptless install path that an agent can run headlessly end to end. Mentions of the CLI and the /caveman invocation describe using the skill, not installing it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end
